content: Sequence layer analogous to News Temporal Context, but for the price mode. The input is the ordered sequence Daily Prices ${\lbrace DP^{sc}_{t-T}, \cdots , DP^{sc}_t \rbrace }$ of size $T$ , where each element the price feature defined in eq:pricemodevec. Particularly, the architecture consists of two stacked LSTM's. The first one outputs for each price feature time step a hidden vector that takes the temporal context into account. Then these hidden vectors are again passed to a second independent LSTM. The layer outputs the price mode encoding Market Price $MP^{sc}_t \in d_{MP}$ . This encoding is the last hidden vector of the second LSTM Market.
